newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS clears Elektrowatt tax questions.
newsitem.headline: CS clears Elektrowatt tax questions.

text.p: ZURICH, May 20 (Reuter ) - CS Group said its plan to split up and sell its Elektrowatt affiliate has been officially confirmed by federal tax authorities and it can now proceed with the transaction.
Last year CS announced a plan to split the energy and industrial company into two units with its energy activities grouped into a company to be called Watt AG.

Following this step CS agreed to sell its stake in Watt to a Swiss-Germany consortium. Last December CS said electronics group Siemens would take over its stake in Electrowatt's industrial activities.

But the company in January said it was changing the split-up procedure as the result of a difference of opinion between Zurich cantonal and Swiss federal tax authorities. -- Zurich Editorial +431 631 7340
